title: The rise of false flag conspiracy theories in moments of crises (ISD)
why: [monitoring report (false-flag template after crises)] Claim: “False flag” claims on X rose >1,100% over five years; ~350% spike Apr–Jun 2025 after DC/Boulder attacks and Israel–Iran escalation (~1m mentions Apr 26–Jun 26). Pattern: high-engagement posts within hours frame real attacks as staged; older false-flag lore (9/11, Oct 7, etc.) recycled as “historical pattern.…
